title: Action Button Voice Recorder: Start Recording With One Press
description: Set the iPhone Action button to start a recording with one press: with Voice Memos, or with Cassette to get a transcript and notes as well.
h1: How to start recording with one press of the Action button
answer: On iPhone models with an Action button, one press can start a recording. Go to Settings, tap Action Button and swipe to Voice Memo to record with Apple's Voice Memos. For a transcript and notes as well, swipe to Controls instead and choose Cassette's Record. Then press and hold the Action button to start a tape, and press and hold it again to stop.
single_os: The Action button is only on iPhone, so this guide is about iPhone.

sections.h: Which iPhones have an Action button

blocks.p: The Action button is the small button on the left edge, above the volume buttons, where older iPhones have the Ring/Silent switch. [Apple lists it](https://support.apple.com/en-us/105103) on iPhone 15 Pro and 15 Pro Max, iPhone 16e and 17e, and iPhone 16 and later. Out of the box it turns Silent mode on and off, but you can give it another job in Settings.

It works with a press and hold, not a quick click. [Apple's words](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/use-and-customize-the-action-button-iphe89d61d66/ios): to perform the action assigned to the Action button, press and hold it. That's what stops it going off in your pocket.

sections.h: Record with Voice Memos, the app already on your iPhone

blocks.p: If you only want to save what was said, Apple's own recorder is one of the choices:

ol: Open the **Settings** app and tap **Action Button**.
Swipe until **Voice Memo** shows under the dots.
Leave Settings. Press and hold the Action button to start recording.

blocks.p: The recording goes into the Voice Memos app. To get the words, open it there and look for the transcript, on the iPhones and languages Apple lists. Our [voice memo guide](/cassette/guides/transcribe-voice-memos/) has the steps, and how to turn a memo into notes.

sections.h: Choose Cassette's Record for the Action button

blocks.p: Cassette is a tape deck for iPhone that writes a transcript and notes from what it records: a short summary, to-dos with names and dates, and the decisions. Its **Record** control goes on the Action button, so one press starts a tape without opening the app. Controls need iOS 18 or later.

ol: Open Cassette once, answer the first question it shows, and press **RECORD**. Allow what it asks for (the microphone, and speech recognition for the transcript), then stop the tape.
Open the **Settings** app and tap **Action Button**. You see the side of the iPhone with a large button in the middle.
Swipe left or right on the button until **Controls** shows under the dots.
Tap **Choose a Control** under it. A list of controls opens, grouped by app.
Scroll to **Cassette**, or type Cassette in **Search Controls**, and tap **Record**.
Back on the Action Button page, it reads **Controls** with **Record** under it. That's it: leave Settings.

alts: The Choose a Control list in iPhone Settings, with Cassette and its Record control.
The Action Button page in iPhone Settings set to Controls, with Record chosen.

blocks.p: To change it later, go back to Settings, Action Button, and tap **Record** under Controls to pick another control, or swipe to another action.

sections.h: Record with it: start, mark and stop a tape

ol: **Start:** press and hold the Action button. A tape starts and Cassette stays closed. REC and the running time show on the Lock Screen, and in the Dynamic Island on iPhones that have one.
**If iPhone asks** whether to allow Live Activities from Cassette, tap **Allow**, so the tape stays in sight while it runs.

**While it records:** lock the phone or use other apps; the tape keeps going and shows on the Lock Screen. On iPhones with the Dynamic Island, touch and hold the REC at the top to see **PAUSE** and **MARK**. Press MARK when something is said that you'll want to find later.
**Stop:** press and hold the Action button again. The tape ends, the same as pressing STOP on the deck, and Cassette writes the transcript and the notes. Open Cassette to read them.

alts: Cassette recording with the app closed: the Dynamic Island opened to REC, SIDE A, the time, the marks count and the PAUSE and MARK keys.
The iPhone Lock Screen with Cassette's tape running: REC, the timer, SIDE A and the marks count.

blocks.p: Full notes need Apple Intelligence on iOS 26 or later. On other iPhones you still get the recording, the transcript and a few lines heard clearly, without the full notes. Recording is free, and a tape under {short_tape_minutes} minutes gets its transcript and notes free, on top of {free_tapes} free tapes a month.

sections.h: No Action button? Put Record in Control Center or on the Lock Screen

blocks.p: The same Record control works in two other places, on any iPhone with iOS 18 or later. Each is one tap: tap to start a tape, and tap again to stop.

ul: **Control Center:** swipe down from the top right corner, tap the **Add** button at the top left, then **Add a Control**, and search for **Cassette**. [Apple's steps](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/use-and-customize-control-center-iph59095ec58/ios) show how to move it once it's there.
**Lock Screen:** touch and hold the Lock Screen, tap **Customize**, then swap one of the two controls at the bottom for Cassette's **Record**.

sections.h: If the button doesn't start a tape

ul: **Nothing happens:** check Settings, Action Button. Controls must have Cassette's Record picked under it, or the button does nothing.

**Cassette opens, or no tape starts:** open Cassette and record one tape from the deck, allowing the microphone and speech recognition when it asks. If you said no before, turn the microphone on in Settings, Privacy & Security, Microphone.
**Silent mode turns on:** the button is still on its first job. Swipe to Controls in Settings, Action Button.
**No Controls in the list:** your iPhone needs iOS 18 or later. Update it in Settings, General, Software Update.

faq.q: Can the Action button start a voice recording?
faq.a: Yes. Set it to Voice Memo to record with Apple's Voice Memos, or set it to Controls and choose Cassette's Record to get a transcript and notes as well. Then press and hold the button.

faq.q: Does Cassette open when I press the Action button?
faq.a: No. Once you have recorded one tape in Cassette and allowed the microphone and speech recognition, the tape starts with the app closed and shows on the Lock Screen while it runs.

faq.q: How do I stop the recording?
faq.a: Press and hold the Action button again. You can also open Cassette and press STOP.

faq.q: Which iPhones have the Action button?
faq.a: Apple lists iPhone 15 Pro and 15 Pro Max, iPhone 16e and 17e, and iPhone 16 and later. On other iPhones, put Cassette's Record in Control Center or on the Lock Screen.
